description_en: Retrieves the relationships between all instances and tags
description_zh: 获取所有实例和标签的关系
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-tag-resources --page 1 --size 10 --resource-type INSTANCE --next-token 1d2db86sca4384811e0b5e8707e000000 --resource-ids es-cn-aaa_,_es-cn-bbb --tags key_:_env_,_value_:_dev_,_key_:_dev_,_value_:_IT --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The page number of the resource relationship list. This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 资源关系列表的分页数，废弃字段
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paged query. This is a deprecated field. Settings for paging are no longer supported
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页条数，废弃字段
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs to query. The value is in JSON array format and supports up to 20 items
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的实例ID列表。采用JSON数组格式，最多支持20个子项
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of tags to query. The value is in JSON string format and contains up to 20 items
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的Tags列表，采用JSON字符串的形式，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tags
